transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our coordination huddle. As you all know, we have one available HLA-selected platelet dose, and we have two inpatients — Patient Cedar and Patient Maple — both with active requests for platelet support. I'll be making the final decision on release, but I need input from each of you before we proceed. Let's first go around and hear from transfusion medicine, cellular therapy coordination, OR scheduling, and regional blood services regarding each patient's situation and any constraints we should be aware of. This will help me determine the best allocation and complete the required release documentation.
